name: Dubai World Central - Al Maktoum International Airport

runway.v: runway 12/30, 4,500 m long and 60 m wide

slots.v: every general aviation flight needs landing permit approval from the Dubai Civil Aviation Authority (DCAA) and an airport slot from the slot coordinator ACL; Dubai World Central is a coordinated (Level 3) airport
slots.quote: No GA Operator is permitted to operate to or from the Airport without first obtaining landing permit approval from the DCAA and an Airport Slot from ACL.

max_aircraft.v: no size limit is stated; operators of the largest aircraft (code F) must apply for schedule clearance at least 72 hours before arrival
max_aircraft.quote: GA Operators using "code F" aircraft must apply for schedule clearance at least seventy-two (72) hours prior to the intended arrival at the Airport.

handling.v: general aviation operators must contract one of the five FBOs before using the airport: ExecuJet, DC Aviation-Al Futtaim, Jet Aviation, Falcon Elite and Jetex
handling.quote: ExecuJet, DC Aviation-Al Futtaim, Jet Aviation, Falcon Elite and Jetex flight support are fixed base Operators

noise.v: Chapter 2 (older, noisier) aircraft may not operate; the airport may prohibit or restrict some aircraft types during noise-sensitive hours (hours not defined)
noise.quote: Chapter 2 Aircraft are prohibited from operating at the Airport.

permits.v: every general aviation flight needs landing permit approval from the Dubai Civil Aviation Authority (DCAA), applied for through its online portal, as well as an ACL slot
permits.quote: No GA Operator is permitted to operate to or from the Airport without first obtaining landing permit approval from the DCAA

catering.v: in-flight catering must come from Emirates Flight Catering; buying on-board catering from airport outlets or third-party suppliers is prohibited
catering.quote: Any in-flight catering requirements shall be addressed to Emirates Flight Catering.

missing: curfew (open 24 hours, but noise-sensitive hours are not defined and no explicit no-curfew statement)
